newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down five cents on lower LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down five cents on lower LME.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down five cents at 14.19 ringgit ($5.71) a kg, pressured by a weaker London Metal Exchange (LME) close on Friday.

"LME was down sharply last Friday but the market here did not fall as much due to demand at the lower levels," said one trader. Turnover was 105 tonnes, up from 79 on Friday, and were taken up by European and local interests.
Traders said the price was unlikely to fall below 14 ringgit, a key support level. The local price premium over LME widened to $80 a tonne against $20 previously.
